units.source_text: 玉鬘的童心中不忘记母亲，上得船来，常常问人：“到妈妈那里去么？”

en.t: In her childish heart, Tamakazura did not forget her mother, and after boarding the boat she would often ask people, "Are we going to where Mother is?"

units.source_text: 乳母听了，眼泪流个不住。

en.t: When her nurse heard this, her tears flowed without stopping.

units.source_text: 乳母的两个女儿也怀念夕颜，陪着流泪。

en.t: The nurse's two daughters also missed Yugao, and wept along with her.

units.source_text: 旁人便劝谏：“船上哭泣是不祥的！”

en.t: The people nearby admonished them, saying, "It is unlucky to cry on a boat!"

units.source_text: 乳母看到一路上美丽的景色，心中想道：“夫人生性娇痴爱玩，倘能看到这一路上美景，何等高兴！

en.t: Seeing the beautiful scenery along the way, the nurse thought to herself, "My lady was by nature innocent, charming, and fond of amusement; how delighted she would have been if she could have seen all this beauty on the journey!

units.source_text: 然而如果她还在，我们也不会远赴筑紫的。”

en.t: And yet, if she were still alive, we would not have gone so far away to Tsukushi."

units.source_text: 她怀念京都，正如古歌所云：“行行渐觉离愁重，却羡使臣去复回。”

en.t: She longed for the capital, just as the old poem says: "The farther I go, the heavier grows the sorrow of parting; I envy the messenger who goes and then returns."
She could not help sinking into a soul-deep melancholy.

units.source_text: 此时船上的梢公粗声粗气地唱起棹歌来：“迢迢到远方，我心好悲伤！”

en.t: Just then, the boatman on board began to sing a rowing song in a rough voice: "Far, far away we go; my heart is full of sorrow!"

units.source_text: 两个女儿听了，更增哀思，相向而泣。

en.t: When the two daughters heard it, their grief deepened, and they turned toward each other and wept.

units.source_text: 船所经行之处是筑前大岛浦，两人便吟诗唱和：

en.t: The boat was passing Oshima Bay in Chikuzen, and the two of them composed poems in exchange:
